name: html-visualization
description: Interactive HTML the user opens in a browser, then sends back to Claude — three user-invoked command skills over a shared html-visualize core, each rendering a different surface: question forms (html-visualize-ask), content for inline commenting (html-visualize-feedback), or static pages with an always-on footer for optional follow-up messages (html-visualize-page); a shared one-shot Node server captures the response and re-invokes Claude
